_comment: The debug scenes the Placeholder Matrix (matrix.lua) lists, in order. stage = the Lua stage folder it opens; price = coins to unlock it once per save (0 = open from the start). name and desc are the English fallbacks; the shown texts are lang/<code>/matrix.json's scenes.<stage>.

scenes.name: Overall Demo
scenes.desc: Five small demos in one stage; the keys 1 to 5 switch between them.

scenes.name: Canvas Demo
scenes.desc: A tiny paint program: draw on a white sheet with the mouse, demonstrating the LuaCanvas + mouse input.

scenes.name: Particle Demo
scenes.desc: A stress test of the Lua3DScene particle engine.

scenes.name: Modal Demo
scenes.desc: Plays the reward and unlock modals of every rarity and type.

scenes.name: AviUtl2 Demo
scenes.desc: AviUtl2 projects (.aup2) played in the video player.
